title: Reading spread, answers
direction: A×C · Round 9 · /insights/revenue-entropy · the note on paper
summary: The approved note (P07) as a reading page: the standfirst at 24px across cols 3–10, the reading column in cols 3–8 at 18px, the margin in cols 10–12 holding only the source and ‘What to look for’ in Mona, and one real control under the paragraph that asks the note's three questions: three rows, each the paragraph's own tag (Narrative · Signal · Memory) and the two answers its question allows (It changes / Nothing lands · We know / We don’t · Written down / Nowhere), in sentence case. The questions are not repeated: each answer group is labelled by its question inside the paragraph (aria-labelledby). An answer that points to a failure fills the row's 6px bar with ink; ‘Where to look first’ and the layer appear in the margin only once there is something to say.
story: The argument itself, verbatim. Round 9 removes the apparatus that read as generated (glyph sidebars, caps note heads, boxed numerals, mono source links, the end square), keeps each source once in the margin, and cuts the self-check's echo: no repeated questions, no 44px symptom quote, no label mirroring the h2, no empty-state line, no storage disclaimer.

reference.site: Approved P07 (round 8) · Tailscale's blog article for the long-form measure
reference.borrowed: A long-form reading column with its sidenotes in a margin, one wide figure that breaks the column once.
reference.kelwin: Paper as the note's document surface; Mona everywhere but the numerals; the kit's segmented control, label and spec list.

motion: entrance: the reading column arrives with its slot; the answer rows rise once when 40% of them are in view (their own IntersectionObserver).

interaction: two answers per question (aria-pressed); a second press clears; the margin result is aria-live and appears only with a flagged layer, or ‘None of the three.’ once all three are answered without one; nothing is stored.
reduced motion: final state at once; the answers still work.
copy: Body [K] verbatim (approved P07), with the standfirst moved here from the head; the three questions wrapped in spans (ids for aria-labelledby), words unchanged
Margin: source 1 (Gartner) in Mona with a sentence-case link; ‘What to look for’ [K]

Answers: ‘Your answers’ (key) · row tags Narrative / Signal / Memory [K, the paragraph's own] · It changes / Nothing lands [K, from the question] · We know / We don’t · Written down / Nowhere [N] · ‘Where to look first’ · result: the layer name(s) or ‘None of the three.’

Cut: ‘One symptom, three causes’ (mirrored the h2), the 44px ‘“We need more pipeline.”’ (repeated the standfirst), the repeated questions and per-row failure titles and layer keys, ‘No answers yet.’, ‘Nothing you click here is stored or sent.’, the layer-glyph key, ‘A Kelwin term · Defined here, once…’ (the <dfn> and its id stay), the boxed numeral, the mono source link, the end square.
phone: ≤1023: the column takes cols 1–8 and the margin cols 9–12 (the result sits there). ≤767: one column, each margin note right after its paragraph; the answers stack under each tag at full width, two equal halves; the result follows the rows once there is one. No overflow at 834 / 390 / 320; nothing under 11px.
notes: A reading surface, taller than the 1400px cap by design (the whole note). Margin notes take their own grid rows from their paragraph's row (no negative margins): a longer note pushes the column apart, never overlaps. Stress-tested with notes grown 4×.
